[[Lon Shevu]] owned and maintained his own '''apartment''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the [[Port Quarter/Legends|Port Quarter]] around the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] around [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. After his death in [[41 ABY]], the apartment was presumably abandoned.
